name: FFS_ACTIVITY_HISTORY
description: Contains an activity modification history to be shown on a corresponding screen.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the activity in Oracle Field Service.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: ID of a parent action_log record.

columns.name: ACTION_TIME
columns.description: Time of the action when it is retrieved by Oracle Field Server. Unix timestamp format. It may be later than the time when the action was actually performed by a user, for example if the action was performed in offline mode.

columns.name: OPERATION_TIME
columns.description: Time when this operation is performed by user (GMT).

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Sequential ID of transaction that defines an order of operations inside of the system.

columns.name: INTERFACE
columns.description: Integer code of an Interface the action is performed from. Possible values: 2 (API); 3 (Core Application); 5 (Inbound API); 8 (Routing); 31 (Android); 32 (iOS).

columns.name: SCREEN_ID
columns.description: ID of the screen the action is performed from (reserved for a future use).

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: ID of the user the operation is performed by.

columns.name: OPERATION
columns.description: Identifier of the performed operation.

columns.name: ROUTE_DATE
columns.description: Date the activity is scheduled to.

columns.name: USER_AGENT_ID
columns.description: ID of the user agent info used to perform the action.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: ID of the resource the activity is assigned to.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the activity after performing the action.

columns.name: ETA
columns.description: ETA of activity after this operation (GMT).

columns.name: LENGTH
columns.description: Duration of the activity after performing the action.

columns.name: TRAVEL
columns.description: Travel time from previous activity.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE
columns.description: New values of affected fields and properties.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Contains unique identifier of the row. System generated.
